cartes: Reign of Elizabeth I: start of British exploration and conquest
Elizabeth I grants the charter to London merchants (East India Company)
East India Company is founded; start of the 1st British Empire
East coast of India comes under East India Company control
Conquest of India (begun in the 17th century) is complete
Persecuted Puritans settle on the east coast of North America
Britain recognises US independence; end of the 1st British Empire
Slave trade declared illegal for British ships
Abolition of slavery throughout the British Empire
End of the Napoleonic wars; start of the 2nd British Empire ("British century")
Colonial Office (Secretary of State for the Colonies)
Conquest of Australia and New Zealand
Government of India Act: the Crown takes over the East India Company's powers
India Office created; the Governor-General becomes Viceroy
Victoria is proclaimed Empress of India (under Disraeli)
Hong Kong becomes a British colony
Berlin Conference on the Congo: partition of Africa among European powers
90% of Africa under European control; peak of the British Empire
Darwin publishes On the Origin of Species
Statute of Westminster; start of the 3rd Empire
India agrees to join the Commonwealth
